subject: Guest auditor access & timeboxed downloads for SOC 2 artifacts
messages:
From: Jane Wright <jane.wright@auditaudit.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditOps <auditops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: auditor guest provisioning + artifact download window

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well. Acme’s external auditor team (Tom Liu, lead auditor) will need temporary access to Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II artifacts and supporting evidence in your trust portal. Can you provision a guest account for Tom that: 
- is timeboxed to a narrow download window (we usually request 48–72 hours),
- supports explicit audit logging (who downloaded what and when), and
- applies watermarking to PDF artifacts if possible?

We prefer a portal guest invite (SAML/Okta guest or temporary portal account) rather than sharing an expiring public link. Please also confirm whether downloads can be restricted by file type and whether you can provide a signed bridge letter covering the period after the report date.

Attached: auditor_id_proof.pdf (Tom’s company ID).

Can you confirm next steps and timeline? The audit kickoff is Nov 2.

Thanks,
Jane Wright
Audit Engagement Lead
Auditaudit Inc.

[attachment: auditor_id_proof.pdf]

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Wright <jane.wright@auditaudit.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: auditor guest provisioning + artifact download window

Hi Jane — thanks for the heads up and for sending Tom’s ID. Looping in Marcus (Security) and Naomi (Compliance) to scope the access pattern and the download SLA. My initial preference is to provide a guest SSO invite via Okta with a strictly timeboxed download window and mandatory MFA. That will give us the best audit trail.

Tentative options for your team to consider: 
- 48-hour download window (default) or 72-hour with elevated approval.
- Watermarked PDFs for sensitive artifacts; raw logs can be redacted on request.
- Enable detailed access logging and provide an access-log export after the window closes.

Marcus/Naomi — can you confirm we can: 1) create a guest account for Tom, 2) enable watermarking and logging, and 3) attach a signed bridge letter for the audit period? If yes, I’ll send the portal invite and the access policy.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

[signature]

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: auditor guest provisioning + artifact download window

Evelyn / team — quick security note and provisioning checklist: 

We can do guest provisioning via Okta B2B invites (recommended) or create a time-limited portal account. Requirements we need from Acme/Tom before provisioning:
- Valid government-issued ID (Jane attached) and auditor firm statement (signed).
- IP ranges for auditor machines (optional; we can restrict if provided).

Security controls we will enable: 
- 48-hour download window by default; we can extend to 72 hours if Compliance signs off.
- Document watermarking (name + company + timestamp) for PDFs exported from the portal.
- DLP: prevent export of raw PII logs; certain internal-only attachments will remain view-only.
- Audit logging: full event stream (view/download) to be exported as CSV after the window.

I’m attaching the provisioning steps we’ll follow. If Acme insists on a 72-hour window, we require a written business justification and their security contact on the ticket.

Marcus Lin
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

[attachment: portal-provisioning-steps.txt]

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: auditor guest provisioning + artifact download window

Jane — thanks, we’re good to proceed. Summary and actions below: 

What we set up:
- Guest account provisioned for Tom Liu via Okta invite. He’ll receive an email to accept and complete MFA.
- Download window: 48 hours starting Nov 2, 09:00 AM EDT (ends Nov 4, 09:00 AM EDT).
- Watermarking: All PDFs exported from the trust portal will include Tom’s name, Acme Corp, and a timestamp.
- Audit logs: We will export a CSV of all access events and share it within 3 business days after the window.
- Bridge letter: Attached (signed) covering the audit period and confirming controls remain in effect as of the report.

Portal invite & links:
- Trust portal: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/acme-audit-2026 (invite is scoped to Tom’s email)
- HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/ACME-789

Attachments provided: bridge_letter.pdf, access_log_policy.txt.

If you need the window extended to 72 hours, please reply with a brief justification and the Acme security contact so Marcus can approve.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
